assertions.name: covariance_epic_phase8_CM_signature_holds_but_CM_refuted
assertions.source: Sign(a_m)=(−1)^m holds n≥8 to order 10 (necessary CM signature) + Σ|a_{m≥2}|<|a_1|; BUT Hankel/moment PSD test fails robustly ⇒ −g' NOT completely monotone ⇒ Bernstein route eliminated (#10). Kernel open. No fit; no c_k.

description: Attack A3, complete-monotonicity route (qou-x631): the sign-alternation SIGNATURE holds but genuine CM is REFUTED. The Taylor coeffs a_m=g^{(m)}(0)/m! of g(θ)=E_{2+θ}[ω₃] follow sign(a_m)=(−1)^m for n=8..17 to order 10 (60-dps) — the necessary part of complete monotonicity of −g' — and Σ_{m≥2}|a_m|<|a_1| for all n. BUT the DECISIVE criterion fails: −g' is CM iff the moment sequence m_k=(k+1)!|a_{k+1}| is Stieltjes ⇔ Hankel H0=[m_{i+j}], H1=[m_{i+j+1}] both PSD; they are NOT (min-eigenvalues negative for essentially all n, robust at 3×3 low-order high-precision and 4×4). So −g' is NOT completely monotone and the Bernstein-representation route (−g'=∫e^{−θs}dμ, μ≥0) is ELIMINATED — sign-alternation is necessary but not sufficient. NET: the signature merely re-expresses the Phase-7 transfer bound |R|<|g'(0)|; no clean shortcut. Route-elimination #10. Kernel remains open. Notation (agent-confirmed): ω₃=p#₃=Σ₃ (3-cycle char). scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 2/7.

data.conclusion: sign-alternation necessary not sufficient; -g' NOT completely monotone
